name: Cart Saver for iHerb
summary: Check official promo codes against your actual iHerb cart, compare totals, and apply your choice. Open source; no signup.
description_en:
Keep the cart. Find the saving.

Cart Saver checks candidate promo codes against your current iHerb cart and shows the measured difference in the displayed total. Click Check my cart, review the result, then choose Apply. No Cart Saver account, AI key or manual code hunting is required.

• Automatically updated official-offer candidates for Australia, the United States and Singapore.
• Country and currency aware: AUD, USD and SGD in this beta.
• Tests up to six codes, then restores your original code when possible. Applying a better result is your choice.
• Explains rejected offers and suggests alternatives when exclusions apply.
• Optional cashback reminders matched to your cashback account market; cashback is separate from instant savings.
• English by default, with a Chinese language switch.
• Open source under the MIT license.

Cart contents and delivery text are processed locally. They are not uploaded to our coupon feed or an AI model. The extension downloads shared public offer data over HTTPS; hosting providers receive ordinary network metadata. No analytics, affiliate substitution or automatic purchases. See the privacy policy for details.

Coupon availability depends on your country, products, account and the merchant's current terms. The beta does not guarantee the lowest price. Review the site's final checkout total before paying. Screenshots show a labelled simulated cart, not a live price offer.

Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by iHerb, Google or cashback providers.
description_zh:
检查你的 iHerb 购物车，看看这单还能省多少。

点击检查，比较网站显示的实际总价，再由你选择应用优惠。无需注册 Cart Saver 账户、配置服务或提供 AI key。

支持澳洲、美国、新加坡及 AUD、USD、SGD；优惠码按收货国家匹配。最多检查六个候选码，完成后尽可能还原原优惠。优惠有排除项时提示原因和替代办法。Cashback 为独立的可选提醒，不计入即时省钱金额。默认英文，一键切换中文。

购物车和配送文字在本地处理，不上传至共享优惠库或 AI。无分析追踪、无联盟标识替换、不代下单。优惠是否适用取决于商品、账户、国家和商家条款，请付款前核对最终总价。截图为明确标注的模拟购物车。

MIT 开源，与 iHerb、Google 及返现平台无隶属或背书关系。
single_purpose: Compare candidate promo codes in the user's iHerb cart and apply the user-selected offer, with optional related cashback information.

permission_justifications.activeTab: After the user clicks the extension, confirm the active page is an iHerb cart and access that tab for the user-requested check.
permission_justifications.scripting: Inject the bundled cart reader and comparison panel on demand; interact only with the site's coupon controls to test, restore and apply codes.
permission_justifications.storage: Store language, optional cashback market and time-limited public coupon-feed cache locally. No personal cart history is persisted.
permission_justifications.alarms: Check periodically whether the shared public feed needs its six-hour refresh; do not collect shopping activity in the background.
permission_justifications.host_permissions: The three specified iHerb hosts provide official public offers and supported carts. The single Vercel host provides the shared HTTPS JSON offer feed. No all-sites permission is requested.

remote_code: No. All executable code is bundled. The remote endpoint returns validated JSON coupon data, not executable code.

data_disclosures.website_content: Yes: visible cart products, quantities, prices, coupon responses and destination text, processed locally for comparison.
data_disclosures.personally_identifiable_information: Yes where destination text contains an address; kept transiently on-device and not uploaded. Hosting also processes normal request IP metadata.
data_disclosures.financial_and_payment_information: Shopping/cart totals are processed locally; no payment card, bank or credit information is read. Select the category if the live form includes purchase/cart information in its definition.
data_disclosures.location: Country and any postcode/address in visible delivery text are used locally; IP metadata reaches hosting. No GPS/geolocation API access.
data_disclosures.web_history: Current active tab URL is inspected only to check it is a supported cart; no cross-site browsing history is read or stored.
data_disclosures.health_personal_communications_authentic: No dedicated collection of health records, communications, passwords, cookies, keystrokes or mouse tracking. Product names can describe supplements; no health profile is inferred.
data_disclosures.use_certifications: Data is not sold, not used or transferred for unrelated purposes, and not used for creditworthiness or lending decisions. Review the live form's exact wording before certifying.

reviewer_instructions: No extension login or API key is needed. In a supported iHerb guest cart with products, set delivery to AU, US or SG and currency to AUD, USD or SGD. Click the extension and Check my cart. Observe country/currency, checked codes and measured totals. The checker temporarily changes the coupon field and restores the original when possible; Apply is explicit. No checkout or payment is needed. The repository demo/index.html is a deterministic fixture for check/restore/apply, rejection advice, language switching and regional cashback; screenshots use that labelled simulation. The public feed endpoint is anonymous. Live SG cart compatibility remains a beta limitation.
